body:
WHY is ecstasy NOT the same?  We remember when we used to rush and feel amazing and be smiling for HOURS.  Now we just feel monged.  There is no rushing.  Not the same level of energy.  And it's not just about age because I see the young people raving often look like zombies.
So the big question is... is that IT where ecstacy is concerned?  Will we never again experience the same levels of euphoria and empathy?  If so, this is tragic indeed.
